name: io.github.glibey/onchain-signals
title: Onchain Signals
description: Pay-per-call Polymarket intelligence for AI agents: MCP server + x402 (USDC) API

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated payer wallet holding a little USDC on Base. Without it only free tools work.

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_ALLOW_MAINNET
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow paying real USDC on Base mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call priced above this (USD, default 0.05).

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_SESSION_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Stop paying after this much in one session (USD, default 1).
